scope: Splendor core game, 1st edition (2014), complete authoritative extracted/splendor-rules.txt. No expansions or later-edition additions.
question_design: Source-rule inventory sweep after combined40 iteration01 found two additional direct coverage gaps. Evaluator saw previous tests.

grading_standard.correct: All requested material facts correct, no unresolved part or contradiction.
grading_standard.partial: Missing or explicitly unresolved requested fact, without material contradiction.
grading_standard.coverage: Correct claims need summary support; unsupported guesses cannot establish pass.

answers.question: During setup, how should the gem and gold supply be arranged: are all tokens mixed together or sorted, how many distinct piles are made, and where should they be placed relative to players?
answers.expected_answer: Sort tokens by color into six distinct piles. Place piles within reach of all players.
material_facts: Sort tokens by color into six distinct piles.
Place piles within reach of all players.
answers.novelty: Source-rule inventory found setup supply arrangement not directly requested before; earlier questions assumed colored piles but did not test six sorted accessible piles.

answers.question: At the end of the final round you have twelve prestige printed on purchased developments, one acquired noble, four unspent gold and five other gem tokens. What is your final prestige score? Do leftover gold or gem tokens add points?
answers.expected_answer: Final prestige is fifteen: twelve from purchased cards plus three from the noble. Unspent gold and other gem tokens add no prestige points.
material_facts: Final prestige is fifteen: twelve from purchased cards plus three from the noble.
Unspent gold and other gem tokens add no prestige points.
answers.novelty: Source-rule inventory found the resource-versus-score boundary: prior scoring scenarios excluded reserved cards, but did not test unused tokens as proposed prestige.
